articles.title: Income Tax Day (Aaykar Diwas) — 24 July
articles.summary: Income Tax Day marks the introduction of income tax in India on 24 July 1860 by Sir James Wilson.
articles.summary_hi: आयकर दिवस भारत में 24 जुलाई 1860 को सर जेम्स विल्सन द्वारा आयकर शुरू होने को चिह्नित करता है।
articles.content:
Income Tax Day (Aaykar Diwas) is observed in India on 24 July every year. It commemorates the introduction of income tax in 1860 by Sir James Wilson after the 1857 revolt strained finances.

The Income Tax Department began observing Aaykar Diwas in 2010 (150 years of income tax). Direct taxes are administered by the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) under the Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance.

The day promotes tax awareness, voluntary compliance, and taxpayer services.

For IB ACIO: date (24 July), year (1860), Sir James Wilson, and CBDT.
articles.content_hi:
24 जुलाई — आयकर दिवस। 1860 में Sir James Wilson।

2010 से Aaykar Diwas। CBDT, वित्त मंत्रालय।

IB ACIO: 24 July, 1860 — याद रखें।
articles.question: Income Tax Day in India is observed on:
articles.question_hi: भारत में आयकर दिवस कब मनाया जाता है?
articles.explanation: Income Tax Day is observed on 24 July to mark the 1860 introduction of income tax.
articles.explanation_hi: आयकर दिवस 1860 में आयकर शुरू होने की याद में 24 जुलाई को मनाया जाता है।
articles.moreInfo: Related preview: 23 July edition. Income-tax Act, 1961 is the principal modern statute.
articles.moreInfo_hi: संबंधित: 23 जुलाई पूर्वावलोकन। Income-tax Act 1961 मुख्य कानून।

articles.title: CBDT vs CBIC — Direct and Indirect Tax Bodies
articles.title_hi: CBDT बनाम CBIC — प्रत्यक्ष और अप्रत्यक्ष कर निकाय
articles.summary: CBDT administers direct taxes; CBIC administers GST and customs — both under the Ministry of Finance.
articles.summary_hi: CBDT प्रत्यक्ष कर; CBIC जीएसटी और सीमा शुल्क — दोनों वित्त मंत्रालय के तहत।
articles.content:
The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) administers income tax and other direct taxes. The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) administers GST (Central), customs, and central excise legacy matters.

Both function under the Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance. Understanding CBDT vs CBIC is a frequent competitive-exam distinction.

Digital compliance tools (e-filing, e-way bill, Faceless Assessment) support modern tax administration.

For IB ACIO: CBDT = direct taxes; CBIC = GST/customs.
articles.content_hi:
CBDT: आयकर। CBIC: GST/कस्टम। दोनों राजस्व विभाग।

IB ACIO: CBDT vs CBIC — याद रखें।
articles.question: Which body administers GST and Customs at the Centre?
articles.question_hi: केंद्र में GST और सीमा शुल्क कौन प्रशासित करता है?
articles.explanation: CBIC administers indirect taxes including GST (Centre) and customs.
articles.explanation_hi: CBIC अप्रत्यक्ष करों — GST (केंद्र) और सीमा शुल्क — का प्रशासन करता है।
articles.moreInfo: Related: today’s Income Tax Day and GST Council (19 July).
articles.moreInfo_hi: संबंधित: आज का आयकर दिवस और GST परिषद।

articles.title: e-Shram Portal — Database of Unorganised Workers
articles.title_hi: ई-श्रम पोर्टल — असंगठित कर्मियों का डेटाबेस
articles.summary: e-Shram creates a national database of unorganised workers to deliver social security and welfare benefits.
articles.summary_hi: ई-श्रम असंगठित कर्मियों का राष्ट्रीय डेटाबेस बनाता है — सामाजिक सुरक्षा और कल्याण लाभ के लिए।
articles.content:
The e-Shram portal was launched by the Ministry of Labour and Employment to register unorganised workers including migrant, construction, and gig/platform workers.

Registration is Aadhaar-seeded and provides a Universal Account Number (UAN). The database helps target social security schemes and emergency assistance.

For IB ACIO: Ministry of Labour & Employment, UAN, and unorganised workers focus.
articles.content_hi:
e-Shram: श्रम एवं रोजगार मंत्रालय। UAN। असंगठित/प्रवासी कर्मी।

IB ACIO: e-Shram, UAN — याद रखें।
articles.question: e-Shram portal is implemented by which Ministry?
articles.question_hi: ई-श्रम पोर्टल किस मंत्रालय द्वारा लागू होता है?
articles.explanation: e-Shram is under the Ministry of Labour and Employment.
articles.explanation_hi: ई-श्रम श्रम एवं रोजगार मंत्रालय के तहत है।

articles.title: WHO — World Health Organization Basics
articles.summary: WHO is a UN specialised agency for international public health, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland.
articles.summary_hi: WHO अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य की UN विशेष एजेंसी है, मुख्यालय जेनेवा।
articles.content:
The World Health Organization was established in 1948. Headquarters: Geneva, Switzerland.

WHO coordinates pandemic response, sets health standards, and can declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). World Health Day is on 7 April.

WHO South-East Asia Regional Office (SEARO) is in New Delhi.

For IB ACIO: founded 1948, HQ Geneva, SEARO New Delhi.
articles.content_hi:
WHO 1948, HQ Geneva। SEARO: नई दिल्ली। World Health Day: 7 अप्रैल।

IB ACIO: 1948, Geneva — याद रखें।
articles.question: Where is the headquarters of WHO?
articles.explanation: WHO is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland.
articles.explanation_hi: WHO का मुख्यालय जेनेवा, स्विट्ज़रलैंड में है।
articles.moreInfo: Upcoming: World Hepatitis Day on 28 July.

articles.title: Param Vir Chakra — Highest Wartime Gallantry Award
articles.title_hi: परम वीर चक्र — सर्वोच्च युद्धकालीन वीरता पुरस्कार
articles.summary: Param Vir Chakra is India’s highest military decoration for valour in the presence of the enemy.
articles.summary_hi: परम वीर चक्र शत्रु की उपस्थिति में वीरता के लिए भारत का सर्वोच्च सैन्य सम्मान है।
articles.content:
Param Vir Chakra (PVC) is India’s highest wartime gallantry award, instituted on 26 January 1950 (effective 15 August 1947).

First recipient: Major Somnath Sharma. Kargil heroes include Capt. Vikram Batra and Capt. Manoj Pandey. Ashoka Chakra is the highest peacetime gallantry award.

For IB ACIO: PVC (wartime), Ashoka Chakra (peacetime), instituted 1950.
articles.content_hi:
PVC: सर्वोच्च युद्धकालीन। अशोक चक्र: शांतिकालीन। प्रथम: मेजर सोमनाथ शर्मा।

IB ACIO: PVC vs Ashoka Chakra — याद रखें।
articles.question: Which is India’s highest wartime gallantry award?
articles.question_hi: भारत का सर्वोच्च युद्धकालीन वीरता पुरस्कार कौन सा है?
articles.explanation: Param Vir Chakra is the highest wartime gallantry award.
articles.explanation_hi: परम वीर चक्र सर्वोच्च युद्धकालीन वीरता पुरस्कार है।
articles.moreInfo: Related: Kargil Vijay Diwas on 26 July.

articles.title: 5G Rollout in India — DoT and TRAI
articles.title_hi: भारत में 5G रोलआउट — DoT और TRAI
articles.summary: India’s 5G services followed spectrum auctions, enabling high-speed and low-latency applications.
articles.summary_hi: भारत की 5G सेवाएं स्पेक्ट्रम नीलामी के बाद — उच्च गति और कम लेटेंसी अनुप्रयोग।
articles.content:
5G offers higher speed, capacity, and ultra-reliable low latency. Spectrum auctions are conducted under the Department of Telecommunications (DoT). TRAI advises on tariffs and telecom policy.

Use cases include IoT, telemedicine, smart manufacturing, and secure communications under Atmanirbhar goals.

For IB ACIO: 5G benefits, DoT auctions, TRAI advisory role.
articles.content_hi:
5G: गति + कम लेटेंसी। DoT नीलामी, TRAI सलाह।

IB ACIO: 5G, DoT — याद रखें।
articles.question: Spectrum auctions for mobile services fall under which department?
articles.question_hi: मोबाइल स्पेक्ट्रम नीलामी किस विभाग के तहत होती है?
articles.explanation: Spectrum auctions are under the Department of Telecommunications.
articles.explanation_hi: स्पेक्ट्रम नीलामी दूरसंचार विभाग के तहत होती है।

articles.title: Ordinance-Making Power — Article 123
articles.summary: Article 123 allows the President to promulgate ordinances when Parliament is not in session.
articles.summary_hi: धारा 123 संसद सत्र न होने पर राष्ट्रपति को अध्यादेश जारी करने देती है।
articles.content:
Under Article 123, the President may promulgate an Ordinance when Parliament is not in session and immediate action is required. It has the force of law.

It must be laid before Parliament and generally ceases six weeks after reassembly unless approved. Article 213 gives similar power to Governors.

For IB ACIO: Article 123 (President), Article 213 (Governor), 6-week rule.
articles.content_hi:
धारा 123 — राष्ट्रपति। धारा 213 — राज्यपाल। 6 सप्ताह नियम।

IB ACIO: 123, 213 — याद रखें।
articles.question: President’s ordinance-making power is under which Article?
articles.question_hi: राष्ट्रपति की अध्यादेश शक्ति किस धारा में है?
articles.explanation: Article 123 empowers the President to issue ordinances.
articles.explanation_hi: धारा 123 राष्ट्रपति को अध्यादेश जारी करने का अधिकार देती है।

articles.title: National Parks vs Wildlife Sanctuaries
articles.summary: National Parks have stricter protection than Wildlife Sanctuaries under the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972.
articles.summary_hi: वन्यजीव संरक्षण अधिनियम 1972 के तहत राष्ट्रीय उद्यानों में अभयारण्यों से सख्त संरक्षण।
articles.content:
Protected Areas under WPA 1972 include National Parks, Wildlife Sanctuaries, Conservation Reserves, and Community Reserves.

National Parks have tighter restrictions; grazing is generally not allowed. Sanctuaries may permit certain local rights with conditions. Jim Corbett is India’s oldest National Park.

For IB ACIO: Park stricter than Sanctuary; Corbett oldest NP.
articles.content_hi:
National Park > Sanctuary सख्ती। Corbett सबसे पुराना NP।

IB ACIO: Park vs Sanctuary — याद रखें।
articles.question: Which generally has stricter protection norms?
articles.question_hi: किसमें सामान्यतः अधिक कठोर संरक्षण होता है?
articles.explanation: National Parks have more stringent restrictions than Sanctuaries.
articles.explanation_hi: राष्ट्रीय उद्यानों में अभयारण्यों से अधिक कठोर प्रतिबंध होते हैं।

articles.title: IAEA — International Atomic Energy Agency
articles.summary: IAEA promotes peaceful nuclear energy and nuclear safeguards; headquarters in Vienna, Austria.
articles.summary_hi: IAEA शांतिपूर्ण परमाणु ऊर्जा और safeguards — मुख्यालय विएना, ऑस्ट्रिया।
articles.content:
The International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) was established in 1957. HQ: Vienna, Austria.

It supports peaceful nuclear applications and implements safeguards against proliferation, working with the NPT framework. India engages IAEA on safeguards for designated civilian facilities.

For IB ACIO: 1957, Vienna, peaceful uses + safeguards.
articles.content_hi:
IAEA 1957, HQ Vienna।

IB ACIO: 1957, Vienna — याद रखें।
articles.question: Where is the headquarters of the IAEA?
articles.explanation: The IAEA is headquartered in Vienna, Austria.
articles.explanation_hi: IAEA का मुख्यालय विएना, ऑस्ट्रिया में है।
articles.moreInfo: Compare: WHO Geneva, ICJ The Hague.

articles.title: Khel Ratna and National Sports Awards — Basics
articles.title_hi: खेल रत्न और राष्ट्रीय खेल पुरस्कार — मूल बातें
articles.summary: Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna is India’s highest sporting honour; awards are often linked to National Sports Day (29 August).
articles.summary_hi: मेजर ध्यान चंद खेल रत्न भारत का सर्वोच्च खेल सम्मान — प्रायः 29 अगस्त राष्ट्रीय खेल दिवस से जुड़ा।
articles.content:
The Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award is the highest sporting honour in India. Other awards include Arjuna, Dronacharya, and Dhyan Chand Award for lifetime achievement.

These are commonly conferred around National Sports Day (29 August), Major Dhyan Chand’s birthday.

For IB ACIO: Khel Ratna highest, 29 August National Sports Day.
articles.content_hi:
Khel Ratna सर्वोच्च। अर्जुन, द्रोणाचार्य। National Sports Day: 29 अगस्त।

IB ACIO: Khel Ratna, 29 August — याद रखें।
articles.question: What is India’s highest sporting honour called?
articles.question_hi: भारत का सर्वोच्च खेल सम्मान क्या कहलाता है?
articles.explanation: Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna is India’s highest sporting honour.
articles.explanation_hi: मेजर ध्यान चंद खेल रत्न भारत का सर्वोच्च खेल सम्मान है।
